protocol-emulator: the only changes to the cmos5l template are the SRAM macro block and the
four FP_PDN_V* stripe keys. Recipe, derivations and risks: docs/hardening.md. Placement
self-check without EDA tools: python3 macros/check_macro_floorplan.py
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
================= SRAM macro integration (docs/hardening.md) =================
Eight RM_IHPSG13_1P_64x16_c2 (236.80 x 64.36 um): per engine e, instruction_sram_e<e>_lo holds
instruction bits 15:0 and _hi bits 31:16. Views are vendored from IHP-Open-PDK 2bbec755
(macros/README.md). Instance keys are the FLATTENED paths: wrapper instance 'core' (src/project.v),
then the flat protocol_emulator_core's instance name (checked with yosys flatten).
x = 11.04 + 67.44 k (k even, so also on the 0.48 um site grid) puts each macro's power columns under
the FP_PDN_V* stripe grid below (src/sram_pdn_cfg.tcl fails the PDN step otherwise).
Bottom row: y 3.78, FS (signal pins on the TOP edge, facing the logic). Top row: y 638.82, N
(pins on the bottom edge, facing the logic; top edge 703.18 < core top 706.86). Top row starts at
x 415.68, clear of the TT I/O pins at x 29.76..191.04 on the top edge. Pairs are 4 stripe pitches
apart (32.96 um gap > 2 x 10 um default halo). The middle 550 um band is free of macros.
lib keys name the process corner, because the cmos5l STA corners are all nom_* (see tt_um_loom).
The fast lib is characterized at -55 C; STA uses it for the -40 C fast corner (conservative).
nl = the interface-only blackbox (never the behavioural model).
Macro supplies: VDD! (periphery) and VDDARRAY! (bit cells) to VPWR, VSS! to VGND (LEF pin names).
PDN_CFG - LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3's default PDN script with its (Metal4<->TopMetal1, hence empty)
macro grid replaced: Metal4 stripes run full height through same-net macro power columns, and the
script fails the PDN step unless every stripe over a macro is inside same-net pins, every macro
supply pin carries a stripe, every stripe meets the precheck power-port rule, and
check_power_grid passes.
SRAM GDS read in full at stream-out (harmless if KLayout does the stream-out on cmos5l).
Magic's cmos5l DRC lacks the SRAM rule exceptions and flags thousands of in-macro errors. Magic DRC
is not part of the cmos5l precheck; the precheck's KLayout SG13CMOS5L deck checks the real GDS.
All Magic markers lie inside the SRAM macros (docs/drc-triage.md); skipping the step saves ~40 min
of the GitHub runner's 6 h limit. KLayout DRC in the precheck is the sign-off check.
Half the 32.96 um gap between paired macros: the halos meet, so no std-cell rows and no short
VPWR/VGND Metal4 straps (which fail the precheck Pin check) are generated between them.
Waived for ONE known case: POWER stripes cross the LEF Metal4 OBS at each macro's VDD!/VDDARRAY!
split (local y 39.085..45.205). The flattened GDS has no Metal4/Via3/TopMetal1 within 1 um of the
stripes inside that band (docs/hardening.md). Expect about 32 overlap boxes (8 macros x 4 stripes,
possibly split); magic__illegal_overlap__count in the metrics must stay at that scale.
Blackbox the SRAM during SPICE extraction for LVS (the IHP macros are not LVS clean).
LibreLane 3.1.0.dev3 computes OpenROAD's thread count as str(OPENROAD_THREADS) or ..., and
str(None) is 'None', so with this key unset every OpenROAD step runs '-threads None' (ORD-0032,
falls back to one thread). Detailed routing of this ~42k-net design then runs for hours.
4 = the vCPU count of the GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runner.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
